explanation: A title that shows respect and reverence for God, used to acknowledge his sovereignty and power.
The upper part of the universe, often associated with God's dwelling place and symbolically representing divine presence and protection.
The planet we live on, created by God and given to humanity as their home.
An expression that refers to people in general, emphasizing our frailty and dependence on God.
Persons or forces that oppose God's will and plans, and who can be a source of evil and suffering in the world.
Used metaphorically to represent speech and communication, especially when it comes to praising and honoring God.
Young people, symbolizing innocence and purity, and serving as an image of the trust and dependence we should have toward God.
Represent God's creative power and skill, and how he has shaped and designed everything in the universe.
Luminous celestial bodies that represent God's greatness and beauty, and serve as signs of his infinite wisdom and creativity.
